_comment: Image generation rules shared by push-product.js and product-feedback-fixes.js. Templates support {BASE} (built from the spec), {SUBJECT} (feedback plan), {GRADE} (from 'grades') and {STYLE} (from 'styles'). Archetypes are matched top to bottom; the first whose channel matches and whose 'match' regex hits product_type + product_name wins. Feedback plans pick an archetype by name.

styles.studio: Commercial product photography, professional studio lighting on a clean white or very light neutral studio background, sharp focus, photorealistic, high resolution. Strictly NO text, NO watermarks, NO logos, NO labels, NO branded props. If a hand appears it must wear a blue or black nitrile glove, never a bare hand.
styles.documentary: Realistic, unstyled documentary photograph taken with a phone or DSLR inside a working, clean, food-grade production room under ordinary ambient light, natural soft shadows, photorealistic, looks like a real supplier photo. It is NOT a studio set: NO softbox visible in frame, NO decorative props, NO items arranged in neat grids or patterns, NO text, NO watermarks, NO timestamps or camera overlays, NO labels, stickers or branding on anything. Clear unlabeled bulk bags ARE allowed. Every surface must look clean and inspected: stainless steel or white surfaces, spotless floors, NO rust, NO grime, NO stains, NO debris. If a hand appears it must wear a blue or black nitrile glove, never a bare hand.

grades.premium: premium grade: uniform, carefully finished, vivid natural color
grades.standard: standard grade: well-formed, consistent, natural color
grades.natural: natural, minimally processed look with rustic texture and natural color variation

reference_prompts.product: The attached photo is the REFERENCE for this exact product. Generate a NEW photo of the IDENTICAL product (same appearance, color, texture and overall look) in a different composition: {PROMPT} The product must be visually consistent with the reference so all listing photos clearly show the same product.
reference_prompts.label: The attached image is the exact printed LABEL ARTWORK for this product. Reproduce this label faithfully on the package (same layout, colors, wording and logo), applied realistically to the package surface with natural perspective and reflections. Do not redesign it, do not change or add any text. {PROMPT}
